evaluation_order: F4 dispersion first; if either target is excluded, record E6 FAIL/STOP and do not continue the remaining oracle comparisons.

F4_dispersion.variable: raw p.82 circle_30in count per physical shot
F4_dispersion.resampling: ordinary nonparametric bootstrap of whole shots, with replacement, ten observations per replicate
F4_dispersion.quantile_method: numpy.quantile(method="linear"): index (B-1)*p, linear interpolation between adjacent sorted values; fixed before calculation
F4_dispersion.decision: lower <= target <= upper, full precision, both ranges required

oracle_comparisons: Not executed before F4 prerequisite; no E6 baseline or case-6 Monte Carlo result exists.
